value.definition: the repository copied out to the destination the repository declares

invariants.statement: The destination is read from the repository the push landed in.
A repository declaring no destination fails rather than passing the copy over.
The copy runs after the push returns rather than while the client waits.
The runner leaves the process group.
The transport sweeps that process group.
The runner has no descriptor the client is waiting on.
One copy runs per repository at a time.
A push arriving while a copy runs leaves a mark the holder takes up.
A history copy pushes every branch and tag as those branches and tags are.
A snapshot copy pushes main's tree onto a lineage rooted at the destination.
A snapshot whose tree is unchanged is a copy that ran and pushed nothing.
A push has a ceiling.
The outcome of the run is left beside the repository for anything to read.

value.definition: a push refused unless it names a change branch or moves main onto one

invariants.statement: A branch created is named for a change or a merge or a project and for a number.
The number tells a merge branch from the merge queue's own ref.
A branch already there is updated and deleted freely.
main is never created and never deleted here.
main only fast-forwards.
main only advances onto a commit an admitted branch already holds.
A branch pushed in the same transaction counts as holding that commit.
One ref refused refuses the whole push.
No push gets past this hook.

value.definition: a push to main refused unless main only goes forward

invariants.statement: main may be created.
A restore pushes into an empty repository.
main may only fast-forward.
main is never deleted.
Every other ref is unconstrained.
This hook is the last point a rewind can be refused before the mirror copies that rewind.
No branch is named or numbered here.
